## Claim — `domain:cli` seat

Session `session_019siH5jDmk5hrayvfyojUqR`, branch `claude/issue-11415-serve-defaults-derived-pin`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` + assignee in one stroke, read back.

**Declared file surface**: `packages/cli/test/serve-defaults.test.ts`.

**Direction** — triage (`5389685334`): *"third home of the literal pin #11046 retired; align with #11046's derived-rule shape rather than re-pinning a literal."* Read what #11046 landed at the other two homes and transplant that shape. ⛔ Do not invent a third way of expressing the rule, and ⛔ do not simply widen `slice(0, 6)` to `slice(0, 7)` — a literal that tracks the list is the same defect with a fresher number.

The defect: the test pins the always-on slate as a literal `slice(0, 6)` under the very instruction ("the list may grow beyond them") that #11046 retired. Derive the slate from whatever declares it, so the pin survives the list growing.

### Serial — checked, and clear

⚠️ This file lives in `packages/cli/test/**`, which in-flight #11341 is building a gate over, and next to the three e2e spawners in-flight #11462 holds. Both were measured before dispatch:

- `serve-defaults.test.ts` is **not a spawner** — zero hits for `...process.env`, `childEnv`, `spawn` and `execa` on `origin/main`. Reverse-checked: the same probe finds bare spreads in ten-plus sibling files, so the zero is a real absence, not a broken probe. ⇒ #11341's gate has nothing to change here.
- #11462 holds `serve-mcp-stdio-answers`, `serve-mcp-capability-collision`, `serve-stdio-stdout-purity` — not this file.

⛔ If your fix turns out to need an edit in any *other* file under that directory, stop and report rather than taking it: two parallel devs are fenced in there this round.

`Clause-②: no` — test-only.

### Anti-vacuity

The pin must be shown failing without the fix, and the interesting direction here is **growth**: with the derived form in place, add a seventh member to whatever declares the slate and confirm the test still passes; with the literal restored, confirm it goes red. That is the property the card is about — a pin that only proves "6 == 6" today would satisfy the letter and miss the point.

Prove mutations on disk by grepping both texts, carry `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, predict the split before running, and record a wrong prediction rather than fitting it.

### Delivery

Changeset: test-only, likely none — say so and why if you skip it. Push, open a **draft** PR with `Fixes #11415`, run the affected suite plus the repo's fast checks, derive the gate set with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, quote each gate's own verdict line. **A gate that refuses is NOT MEASURED.** Keep the report proportionate to the diff.

## Review complete — ⛔ arming waits on CI only

`domain:cli` seat, session `session_019siH5jDmk5hrayvfyojUqR`. PR **#11605** @ `ef32d56e`. Reviewed and **approved on substance**; the only thing outstanding is CI, which at read time still had `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Build Core`, `Type Check · debt ledger` and four Dogfood shards `in_progress`. ⛔ `in_progress` is not `success`.

`Clause-②: no` — test-only, one file, as declared.

### ⭐ The ablation measured the reason this card exists, not just the fix

The dispatch said the interesting direction is **growth**, because a pin that only proves "6 == 6" satisfies the letter and misses the point. The four legs answer exactly that, with the mutation being a **seventh foundational member** inserted after `settings` — legitimate growth, not a corruption:

| leg | shape | predicted | measured |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | derived + grown | PASS | 7 passed |
| B | literal + grown | FAIL | 1 failed — `leads with the six foundational capabilities in stable order`, diff `+"os_ablation_secrets"@4 / -"storage"` |
| C | literal + unchanged | PASS | 5 passed — **today's vacuous green, named as such** |
| D | derived + unchanged | PASS | 7 passed |

Leg C is the card. It is the state `main` is in right now: green, and green for no reason. Measuring it rather than asserting it is what makes B's red meaningful.

All four predictions recorded before running and all four matched — nothing fitted.

### ⭐⭐ The dist handling is the strongest this lane has seen this round

`packages/cli` does not alias `@objectstack/spec` (its `vitest.config.ts` aliases only `service-cache`, `create-objectstack/created-summary`, `plugin-auth`), so `serve.ts` resolves `@objectstack/spec/kernel` through `exports` into `packages/spec/dist/`. That is the exact configuration that has produced false greens twice in this repo this week.

The dev did not "rebuild between legs" — it applied the mutation **to the resolved artifact itself**, in all 8 non-map dist files carrying the slate, so *the src→dist gap is absent rather than merely closed*. And it confirmed that with **two independent instruments before reading any colour**: `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` → `marker present in 8 built files -- the ablation is live in the artifact the suite consumes`, plus a property read → `slate len 11 | index of marker 4`. The restore leg was run and confirmed the same way in the opposite direction — `marker absent from all 209 built files`, `restored slate len 10 | marker index -1`.

### Transplanted, not reinvented — and not widened

The derived-rule shape comes from #11046's other two homes (`platform-capabilities.test.ts` @ `68e8b4b5`, and case 5 of `serve-settings-ordering.pin.test.ts`): `BIND_TARGETS` as a **role**, one shared `orderingViolations` predicate, a floor case, the derived boundary with a non-vacuity tail check, and a falsifiability case with two positive controls. ⛔ `slice(0, 7)` — the "same defect with a fresher number" the dispatch forbade — was not taken.

### Two refusals, correctly reported as NOT MEASURED

`check:i18n` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the workspace CLI is not built`; `check:i18n-coverage` first answered `COULD NOT MEASURE — 1 of 12 config(s) failed to lint` (connector-mcp had no dist). Both were rebuilt and re-run green, **and the report's table quotes only the runs that actually measured**. A refusal reported as a pass is the failure mode; neither happened here.

Repo-wide `pnpm lint` run whole — 5325 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, count read from `--format json`, so no narrowing was claimed.

### The finding it declined to fold, with the right reason

**#11594** — `service-sms/src/sms-plugin.ts` still describes the retired `slice(0, 6)` prefix pin in the present tense. Named by this card's own "Suggested work", and still **not folded**: it sits in a **second package**, outside the declared surface, and *"taking it would have widened this PR's verification surface for a comment with no behaviour, so bounded-in-place condition 4 fails and I took the default path."*

⭐ That is the exemption applied correctly — the four conditions are a conjunction, and one failing sends you to the default, not to a judgement call. It also checked for collisions first: no open PR touches `packages/services/service-sms/**`, no open issue names it.
